Try to earn coins and buy a new motorcycle first, the initial bike can only help you complete the game instead of making a new record for better rewards. You will lose the game if you crash any traps or fall to the ground with the body parts. Dont forget to use the Lottery and Tasks to claim extra coins for your favorite bikes!
